# sinowisp (bundled)

`sinowisp.exe` is the unmodified Windows build of [sinowisp](https://github.com/karstx/sinowisp)
**v2.1.0** (formerly `sinowealth-kb-tool`) by Karolis Stasaitis. It's an open-source tool for reading and
writing flash on SinoWealth 8051 keyboards through their ISP bootloader. K580 Control uses it only for the
Firmware page.

- Source: release asset `sinowisp-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-v2.1.0.tar.gz`
- SHA-256 of `sinowisp.exe`: `321910b82185567afb1bbb9520e08ccecc009382fb8c8d179096b9f54f6997d7`
